title: Final Capacitance
description: Essential Criteria: The student must provide the correct expression for the capacitance of the system, C = 4 pi epsilon_0 a d / (d - a).

title: Charge Distribution
description: Essential Criteria: The student must correctly express the charge distribution on the inner and outer surfaces of the middle shell in terms of Q_B.

title: Electric Field Equations
description: Important Criteria: The student should derive and present the electric field equations for the regions between the shells.

title: Potential Equality
description: Important Criteria: The student must explain the condition of equal potential between the inner and outer shells.

title: Sign Errors
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student should avoid sign mistakes in the expressions for charges Q_1 and Q_2.

title: Units Consistency
description: Optional Criteria: The student should check that all units are consistent throughout the calculations.

title: Limiting Cases
description: Optional Criteria: The student may discuss limiting cases or special scenarios for further insight.
